title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → FederalAidReport

source_tables.description: COD batches and responses: batch ID, records sent, accepted, rejected, error codes. FLAG: confirm delivered COD record names.
FISAP data for campus-based programs. FLAG: confirm; many schools build FISAP from queries.
Disbursement totals by fund, for reconciliation.
Enrollment reporting files (usually through the Clearinghouse). Not stored as a PeopleSoft record at most schools.

notes: This resource is institution-level and has no student rows. Build most fields in silver by aggregating HELIX Disbursement and comparing to COD school account statements. Research roles can read it under ACM-SPECIAL-010 because it carries no student rows.
privacy: Institution-level aggregates with no student rows. Default classification is confidential; ACM-SPECIAL-010 lets research roles read it because it carries no student-level data. Small counts still follow govern/ferpa-suppression-policy.json when published.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + report_type + AID_YEAR + batch or period.
COD batch -> cod; FISAP -> fisap; NSLDS enrollment -> nslds; Pell and DL reconciliation runs -> pell_reconciliation, dl_reconciliation.
Map to draft, submitted, accepted, rejected, partially_accepted, resubmitted.
From HELIX Disbursement. Must equal the COD school account statement.
Federal plus institutional share, per FISAP rules.
School total minus COD total. Zero is the target every month.
balanced when variance is zero; variance_identified, resolved, pending otherwise.
